Ram Mandir Donation Theft Allegations Spark Scrutiny and Questions

Allegations of irregularities in the collection of donations for the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya have surfaced, with reports of a "scam" or "theft" involving significant sums. Investigations are reportedly focusing on banking procedures and the roles of individuals associated with the temple trust. Questions have been raised about accountability and the handling of funds, leading to public and political reactions.
